verdict.rationale: smolagents explicitly adopts OpenTelemetry for instrumenting agent runs, documented in a dedicated 'inspect_runs' tutorial, enabling tracing of LLM calls and tool invocations in observability UIs (e.g., compatible OTel backends). It also supports agent.replay() for local run inspection. missing for 10: no explicit named integration with a specific observability UI (e.g., Langfuse/Arize) shown in evidence, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of trace fidelity.
